text_block_list.text:
The sky was blue. And the sun was shining.
A place where 
the Uma Musume grew by training together.
Summer Training 
Camp had arrived! Or at least,
it should have――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Tore-cchi~! Over here, over here♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu, when it comes to summer,
it's all about vacations~! 
Let's enjoy today to the fullest~♪

Together with Vivlos,
I was at a luxury resort. 
And that was because――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, Tore-cchi,
I want to ask you for a favor♪ 
I'll work really rea~lly hard at summer camp!
So♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
On our day off, let's go on a date♡ 
Mama gave me some resort tickets~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyday, we've been working really hard,
after all! 
Let's spend today getting refreshed,
Tore-cchi♡

In fact,
Vivlos had worked incredibly hard during
summer camp. 
So she could refresh……today I was accompanying
her――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And with that said……Tore-cchi,
what do you want to do!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmmm~♡ This smoothie is delicious!
It's got a slightly 
salty and revitalizing taste,
doesn't it!? Tore-cchi♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
I'm the type that usually can't decide! 
Hmmmm,
so this is the kind of thing Tore-cchi
likes.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And so,
what should we do next??
This place is really spacious 
and there are quite a few entertainment
facilities~!
choice_data_list: ……is there something you want to do?
……is there something you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eh-? If it's something I want to do,
I'm already 
doing it though?
『I want to do what Tore-cchi wants 
to do!』 That's what today's all about♡

And so, because 『It's what I want to do』,
we were now at 
……a place where we could find the world's
fastest animal――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hoeh~ cheetahs can run at speeds up to
100km/h. 
Even though they've got thighs that are that
thin!
choice_data_list: They use their whole body to run!
They use their whole body to run!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaa! Tore-cchi,
your eyes are sparkling! 
Your brain's filled with racing isn't
it~!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to relieve that exhaustion,
then how about 
this Hotel Spa!?
It's Verxina Onee-chan's favorite place!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It'll fix that weary body right up like
new-♪

I was taken to a dark room with a faint
aroma 
……I could feel it relieving the fatigue.
I see 
……the healing effects of this place were
amazing.

This gave me an idea……for Vivlos'…… 
……Train……-ing…… too………… ………………

――……Tore-cchi…… 
……――……Heeeey……you awake……~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're awake! Good morning♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it!
If this spa made you feel better,
then I'm glad♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you hungry?
It's right about dinner time, 
do you want to go get something to eat?
choice_data_list: Well, maybe some place near the oc...

text_block_list.name: Hotel Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Vivlos-kun and……are they your
trainer? 
Welcome to our hotel.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, Owner-chan!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
――Right! A friend of the family. 
You see, Owner-chan,
I came to check out the spa with
Tore-cchi~!

text_block_list.name: Hotel Owner
text_block_list.text:
I see.
……have you decided on where to have dinner
yet? 
If you haven't, how about joining us?

text_block_list.name: Hotel Owner
text_block_list.text:
Using the latest trend of ingredients,
an Italian course. 
And while enjoying the night view……how about
telling me 
more about how your competitions are
going?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Waah,
is it the one that's making a buzz on
SNS!? 
Sounds great~~♪ But――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Today we were thinking of finding a place
down by the beach! 
Let's talk again next time!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then, let's get going! Tore-cchi,
what do you want to eat-?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
He's not the kind of person to get mad over
that! 
Besides……――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I already told you, didn't I? 
Today,
I want to do what Tore-cchi wants to do♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew~~! I'm stuffed! 
Mmm~……and the sea breeze feels nice……it's
the best, isn't it?

We were relaxing and watching the sunset
while enjoying 
the cool breeze. It was a pleasant time,
with our stomachs 
full and our hearts at ease……

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ! ……Really?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alllllright~~……!
That means the 『Take Care of 
Tore-cchi Strategy』 was a huge success~♡♡♡

Vivlos seemed to be having fun. 
It sounds like……her entire goal for today
was to prioritize me.

Certainly, because of her 『Taking Care』 of me,
I felt relieved. 
……However――
choice_data_list: But it probably wasn't as fun for ...
But it probably wasn't as fun for ...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? That's not true though? After all――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
……Hey, do you remember? 
That day we went to the street market
together?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Just like how I'm excited with new things,
in the time we spend 
together,
there are also all kinds of other exciting
moments.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I realized it on that day, 
I've wanted to find more of those moments,
no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Like that old man's bag,
and Tore-cchi's bag. 
I was……wondering if I also had those kinds
of 
exciting moments that I would want to treasure
forever.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And then,
I kept looking and looking……and I found
it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That strict and serious figure during training.
That laid-back 
look while being healed,
and that blissful sleeping face.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trendy items, and even this dinner,
can't beat that.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
After all――when it comes to you,
I can't help but feel excited!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe. ……without a doubt, this evening will 
definitely become an exciting memory,
right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we take it easy for just a bit
longer?

With a gentle sound,
I felt a weight on my shoulder. 
For a short while,
I watched the sunset together with Vivlos.
